origin.description: Compose a concordance with the previous one.
origin.details: Each current source line is looked up in the previous map. NA in the previous map keeps the current file and line.
origin.value: The current concordance, with srcFile and srcLine updated.

translation.description: Compose a concordance with the previous one.
translation.details: None in the previous map keeps the current file and line.
translation.value: A dict with offset, srcFile, and srcLine.
translation.example:
from tools import follow_concordance
print(follow_concordance({"offset": 0, "srcFile": "a.Rnw", "srcLine": [1]}, None))
